topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: I must admit, I had my doubts all along. The texts getting more sparse, the casual mentions of being too busy to get together, it all seemed a bit off. Yet, I played along, keeping my wise observations to myself. So, when I finally got the call that the surprise party had been scrubbed, I couldn’t help but feel a certain sense of validation. I’ve always trusted my instincts. Perhaps it was for the best; I’ve never been one for theatrics, anyway. My friends were only trying to set the stage for some drama, but I prefer my life in more understated tones. Now, I can enjoy my evening in peace, perhaps with a good book, a glass of wine, and the quiet certainty that I knew better all along.
